proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Code P0420 and a parts store told me I needed a converter. Curt tested the sensors first, found a bad downstream oxygen sensor and an exhaust leak ahead of it. A fraction of the converter price.
reviews.name: Wes T.

reviews.text: My pickup stalled at stoplights, never on the highway. They watched the live data on a drive out to Lockwood and found a dirty throttle body. Cleaned it, no parts.
reviews.name: Rhonda M.

reviews.text: Battery kept going flat overnight. They put a meter on it and pulled fuses one at a time until they found an aftermarket stereo amp drawing power. I finally understand why.
reviews.name: Isaac B.

reviews.text: The text said: front pads at 3 mm, rears at 7 mm, rotors in spec. Do the fronts this month, rears next year. That's exactly the kind of answer I want from a shop.
reviews.name: Megan H.

reviews.text: Humming got louder above fifty on my drive in from Shepherd. Left front wheel bearing, confirmed on the lift with the wheel off. Fixed it in an afternoon and the noise is gone.
reviews.name: Clint A.

reviews.text: Before driving to see family in Rapid City, they found a cracked heater hose and a glazed belt. Two small fixes, and I wasn't stuck on I-90 in February.
reviews.name: Faye N.

proof.guarantee: If the repair we recommend doesn't fix the problem it was for, the next round of testing is on us.
